text: Identification of the original meeting instruction message for which the global status or the status(es) of one or more individual instructions are provided.
Identification of the original meeting instruction cancellation request message for which the global status or the status(es) of one or more individual instruction cancellation requests are provided.
Status of each individual meeting instruction(s) included in the instruction message identified in InstructionType/InstructionIdentification.

Status of the meeting instruction cancellation request message or of the individual meeting instruction cancellation request(s). The message is identified in InstructionType/InstructionCancellationIdentification.
